blocks.text: Zameen ke gird woh khala jis mein us ki gravitational force kisi jism par lagti hai gravitational field kehlati hai. Jab koi cheez gravitational field mein hilai jaye to kaam gravitational force karti hai: agar displacement gravitational force ki simt mein ho to kaam musbat hai, aur agar displacement gravitational force ke khilaf ho to kaam manfi kehlata hai. Gravitational force ki ek dilchasp khoobi hai: jab koi cheez ek jagah se doosri jagah hilai jaye to gravitational force ka kiya kaam raste ke intikhab par munhasir nahi.

Mass m ki cheez lein jo gravitational force ki maujoodgi mein mustaqil speed se nuqte A se nuqte B tak mukhtalif raston par hilai jati hai (Fig. 4.9); gravitational force cheez ke wazan mg ke barabar hai. Raste 1 (ADB) par gravitational force ka kiya kaam do hisson mein toota ja sakta hai: AD par kaam sifr hai, kyunke wazan mg is raste par amood hai; DB par kaam -mgh hai, kyunke mg ki simt displacement ki simt ke ulat hai (theta = 180 degrees). Is liye raste 1 se jism ko A se B tak hilane ka kaam W_ADB = 0 + (-mgh) = -mgh. Raste 2 (ACB) par AC ka kaam bhi -mgh hai aur CB ka kaam sifr, to W_ACB = -mgh + 0 = -mgh. Ab rasta 3 lein, jo mura hua hai: use ufqi aur amoodi qadmon ke silsile mein toota hua sochein (Fig. 4.10). Ufqi qadmon par koi kaam nahi hota, kyunke wahan mg displacement par amood hai; gravity ka kaam sirf amoodi displacements par hota hai. Hisse AB ke doran mg manfi nahi, musbat hai, magar sab delta y ajza manfi hain, to sab ajza ke liye mg aur delta y ke hasil-e-zarb phir manfi hain: W_AB = -mg (delta y1 + delta y2 + delta y3 + ... + delta yn), aur chunke delta y1 + delta y2 + ... + delta yn = h, W_AB = -mgh. Raste AB par khalis kaam ab bhi -mgh hai. Hamwar rasta be-intiha chhoti x aur y displacements ke silsile se badla ja sakta hai; kaam sirf y displacements ke doran hota hai.

blocks.alt: Jism zameen par point A se unchai h par platform ke point B tak teen raaston se le jaya jata hai: path 1 zameen ke saath D tak phir seedha oopar, path 2 seedha oopar C tak phir aar-paar, aur path 3 aik balkhati curve. Wazan mg neeche ki taraf hai. Note kehta hai har raaste par gravity ke khilaf kaam mgh hai.
blocks.caption: Gravity ke khilaf A se B tak teen raaste (Figure 4.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: A se unchai h par B tak neeli curve, chhote qadmon ki seerhi se bani: naranji ufqi qadam, surkh oopar ke qadam aur hare neeche ke qadam. Note kehta hai ufqi qadmon mein gravity ke khilaf kaam nahi, aur oopar ke qadam minus neeche ke qadam h banate hain, is liye kaam mgh hai.
blocks.caption: Mura hua raasta chhote ufqi aur amoodi qadmon ki shakal mein (Figure 4.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Conservative force
blocks.text: Gravitational force ka kiya kaam raste se azaad hai. Kya aap sabit kar sakte hain ke ACBA ya ADBA jaise band raste par (Fig. 4.9) gravitational force ka kiya kaam sifr hai? Agar kisi force ka do nuqton ke darmiyan cheez hilane ka kaam raste se azaad ho, ya band raste par kiya kaam sifr ho, to force conservative force kehlati hai. Gravitational force conservative hai; doosri misalein electrostatic force aur elastic spring force hain.

blocks.title: Non-conservative force
blocks.text: Sab forces conservative nahi hotin. Force non-conservative hai agar us ka do nuqton ke darmiyan, ya band raste par, cheez hilane ka kaam harkat ke raste par munhasir ho.

Kinetic raghrat ki force non-conservative hai. Jab cheez satah par phisalti hai to kinetic raghrat ki force harkat ke ulat lagti hai aur raghrat ki force zarb raste ki lambai ke barabar miqdar ka manfi kaam karti hai; yun kisi do nuqton ke darmiyan lambe raste par zyada kaam hota hai, to kaam raste ke intikhab par munhasir hai. Mazeed yeh ke band raste par non-conservative force ka kul kaam sifr nahi hota. Non-conservative force ki doosri misalein hawa ki rukawat, dori ki tension, normal force aur rocket ki propulsion force hain.

blocks.prompt: 2 kg ki cheez 5 m oopar phenki jati hai aur wapas girti hai. Oopar jate, neeche aate aur kul gravity ka kaam nikalein (numerical problem 4.6). Raghrat ke khilaf kaam non-conservative kyun hai (constructed response 4.6)?
blocks.explanation: Oopar: displacement gravity ke ulat, W = -mgh = -2 x 9.8 x 5 = -98 J; neeche: +98 J; kul 0 J, jo dikhata hai ke band raste par gravity cheez ko koi khalis energy muntaqil nahi karti, jaisa conservative force ko hona chahiye. Raghrat hamesha harkat ki mukhalif hai, to har hisse par us ka kaam manfi hai; band raste par hisse katne ke bajaye jama hote hain, aur lamba rasta zyada kharch karta hai, to kaam raste par munhasir hai.

items: Gravitational field: woh khala jahan gravity lagti hai. A se B tak kisi bhi raste se (ADB, ACB, qadmon ki tarah mura) gravity -mgh karti hai; band raste par sifr: conservative force (gravity, electrostatic, spring).
Non-conservative: kaam raste par munhasir aur chakkar par sifr nahi: kinetic raghrat (manfi kaam f zarb raste ki lambai), hawa ki rukawat, tension, normal force, rocket propulsion.
